sources.entry: Aural Player - Aural Player is a audio player application for the macOS platform. Inspired by the classic Winamp player for Windows, it is designed to be to-the-point and easy to use.

summary.one_liner: Aural Player is a macOS audio player inspired by Winamp, described as to-the-point and easy to use, and the project is now archived.
summary.what_it_does: The README is only a short archive notice, so it does not document any features beyond the listing description. The listing describes it as an audio player for macOS, inspired by the classic Winamp player for Windows, designed to be simple and easy to use. The author says there will be no further bug fixes, features, or releases. One final release is available under the repository's Releases section.
use_cases: playing local audio files on a mac
how_to_run: Download the final release from the repository's Releases page
notable: Inspired by the classic Winamp player for Windows
Designed to be to-the-point and easy to use
Final release available; no further development
caveats: Project is archived: no bug fixes, new features, or new releases
Author makes no claims that the final release will work for any given user
